rules.retained_active_source: Reviewed active foundation file retained byte-for-byte from the immutable source commit.
rules.retained_historical_evidence: Historical, benchmark, audit, handoff, plan, or compatibility evidence retained byte-for-byte but not treated as current authority.
rules.reviewed_target_rewrite: Reviewed target implementation intentionally differs from the immutable source and is bound to the recorded target blob.
rules.excluded_dead_delivery: Dead, duplicate, or unsafe delivery path excluded while remaining recoverable from the immutable source commit.
rules.excluded_web_first: Mobile scaffold or mobile-only dependency excluded from the authorized web-first target.
rules.excluded_one_shot_mutator: One-shot source mutation utility excluded so it cannot compete with maintained runtime authority.
rules.excluded_legacy_provider: Legacy non-OpenAI provider or provider-adjacent data seam excluded from active target delivery.
rules.excluded_seed_authority: Stale generated or one-shot seed authority excluded in favor of migrations and captured ledger contracts.
rules.reviewed_target_native: New target-native source or test reviewed in the frozen target snapshot and bound to its exact mode, size, and Git blob.
